stefan_boltzmann_luminosity.purpose: derive stellar luminosity from radius and effective temperature
stefan_boltzmann_luminosity.limitations: Assumes effective temperature and spherical radiating surface.

planet_equilibrium_temperature.purpose: zero-albedo full-redistribution equilibrium temperature used by the NASA Exoplanet Archive calculation page
planet_equilibrium_temperature.limitations: Not a surface temperature or climate prediction; ignores greenhouse effects, albedo variation, and heat redistribution differences.

planet_insolation.purpose: incident stellar flux relative to Earth
planet_insolation.limitations: Bolometric flux alone does not establish climate or habitability.

kepler_period.purpose: two-body orbital-period approximation for planet mass much smaller than stellar mass
kepler_period.limitations: Does not include planet mass, perturbations, relativity, or multi-body integrations.

mass_from_radius_density.purpose: derive bulk mass from generated radius and density
mass_from_radius_density.limitations: Only as good as the generated density prior.

starter_temperate_flux_screen.limitations: AXM starter heuristic only; not the Kopparapu climate model and never a habitability claim.

display_temperature_bucket.expression: categorical display mapping from effective temperature
display_temperature_bucket.limitations: Not a spectrum renderer or calibrated color transform.

kepler_orbital_phase.purpose: advance deterministic orbital phase and star distance before each action
kepler_orbital_phase.limitations: Two-body Keplerian orbit; no perturbations, precession, relativity, or N-body integration.

photon_counting_snr.expression: SNR = S / sqrt(S + B + D + n_pix*n_read*sigma_read^2 + sigma_systematic^2)
photon_counting_snr.purpose: predict instrument signal-to-noise before entropy and generate a separate noisy realized measurement afterward
photon_counting_snr.limitations: Representative detector model, fixed wavelength and configurable synthetic instrument parameters; not calibrated flight hardware.

spacecraft_thermal_balance.purpose: couple stellar flux, attitude, instrument use, inherited heat, and radiator capacity to action outcomes
spacecraft_thermal_balance.limitations: Lumped steady-state power balance; no finite-element geometry, transient node network, conduction path, or material degradation.

light_time_delay.purpose: make command, telemetry, and discussion delays depend on actual simulated distance
light_time_delay.limitations: Vacuum propagation plus a simplified fixed link rate; no occultation, coding, antenna gain, or network scheduling model.

hohmann_reference_transfer.expression: t_transfer = pi*sqrt(((r1+r2)/2)^3/mu); delta_v from circular and transfer-orbit vis-viva speeds
hohmann_reference_transfer.purpose: provide a transparent two-impulse reference trajectory for probe travel and follow-up timing
hohmann_reference_transfer.limitations: Reference transfer only; no launch-window phasing, plane changes, finite burns, perturbations, or mission optimization.

radiation_operational_risk_index.purpose: couple stellar environment and shielding to electronics/operations risk bands
radiation_operational_risk_index.limitations: AXM relative gameplay index only; not particle transport, absorbed dose, single-event-effect prediction, or medical exposure.

product_of_catalog_values.purpose: derive transparent capacity totals only from pinned catalog facts
product_of_catalog_values.limitations: Arithmetic does not imply operational margin, simultaneous availability, or mission approval.

sum_nameplate_power.purpose: sum published installed thruster nameplate input powers
sum_nameplate_power.limitations: Nameplate sum is not a claim that every thruster can or will operate simultaneously, nor that all generated platform power is available to propulsion.

inverse_parallax_nearby_demo.purpose: derive starter-atlas distances for nearby, high signal-to-noise landmarks
inverse_parallax_nearby_demo.limitations: Naive parallax inversion is not a general distance estimator. It is used here only for nearby demonstration records with small relative parallax errors.

icrs_spherical_to_cartesian.expression: x=d cos(dec) cos(ra); y=d cos(dec) sin(ra); z=d sin(dec)
icrs_spherical_to_cartesian.purpose: project source-pinned ICRS direction and distance into a heliocentric Cartesian atlas display
icrs_spherical_to_cartesian.limitations: A coordinate projection is not a navigation solution. Epoch, proper motion, radial motion, covariance, and reference-frame details remain separate.

linear_proper_motion_display.purpose: small-angle display propagation of catalog landmarks
linear_proper_motion_display.limitations: Display only; excludes perspective acceleration, covariance propagation, multiplicity, and precision ephemeris requirements.
